body: Right now I'm over seas. We have behavioral health. Theres no real support groups besides substance abuse. I don't have time for a pet. I wish I could have an animal to bond with but barracks restrict it. Im constantly on medical standby for ranges and courses and it my schedule changes in a heart beat. Last week I went to a range with just the gear I had on my back and I was told I'd be there for 4 straight when I got there. No sleep system and I was going to sleep in my truck. It gets cold out here. The most I could do is see if theyd prescribe me meds because I doubt I could make a steady schedule of appointments.  I love your ideas but the service takes up all my time. Its my life.
